label: S&P 500

label: Nvidia after CEO exit
change: −2.01% on Fri and −12.75% for the week (a sixth straight weekly fall), about 32% below its October record, after Jensen Huang resigned on 12 Nov. Weekend: the FT reports Huang is weighing a comeback, and Treasury Secretary Bessent questioned Nvidia’s export-control compliance and urged an outside CEO. Shares were little changed in Sunday-evening trading. Results Tue 17 Nov (Wed ~8:20am Melbourne)

label: VIX volatility index

source: CappNotes 13 Nov; The Glass Desk 13 Nov

change: Last published level a record 1,268 bp on 5 Nov; no newer figure. change: An all-time annual record, passing 2020, driven by AI borrowing

change: 320 bp on 12 Nov, down from 330 bp; investment-grade 89 bp. Broad junk bonds keep tightening even as AI names swing

label: Big-tech capex outlook
change: No hyperscaler has cut 2027 plans (Alphabet and Amazon: 'significantly' more). New risk is political: after the Democratic sweep, UBS estimates ~30% of expected 2028 US data-centre capacity additions could be at risk from construction pauses, and Microsoft is reportedly tightening oversight of neocloud projects. Microsoft +6.7% and Amazon +6.1% on Wed, then −3.6% and −2.2% Thu
